ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a local map viewed from above the North Pole, with meridians radiating outward from the center of the circle. The horizontal radius on the right is labeled as the 180° meridian. There is shading outside the oblique line on the left side, representing the night hemisphere; the right side and most of the inside of the circle are blank, representing the day hemisphere. The oblique line between the shaded and blank areas is the day-night boundary, namely the terminator. Reasoning: The meridian where the direct solar point is located should be perpendicular to the terminator, and the perpendicular direction should point toward the blank day hemisphere. Judging from the meridian intervals in the figure and the position of the 180° meridian on the right, this solar meridian pointing toward the day hemisphere deviates westward by 33.75° relative to the 180° meridian. Therefore, the longitude of the direct solar point is 180°−33.75°=146.25°E.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：圆内有放射状经线，右侧标注180°，左侧斜线外的阴影为夜，右侧空白为昼。把斜的昼夜分界线认作晨昏线，作其垂线并取指向空白昼半球的一侧，该垂线即太阳直射点所在经线。根据图中经线间隔和180°标注，量得该太阳经线相对180°经线偏差33.75°，故太阳直射点经度为180°−33.75°=146.25°E。

推理：太阳直射点所在经线应与晨昏线垂直，并且垂线方向要指向空白的昼半球。按图中经线间隔与右侧180°经线的位置判断，这条指向昼半球的太阳经线相对于180°经线向西偏差33.75°。因此太阳直射点经度为180°−33.75°=146.25°E。
